name: Morse.Homology.relChains
why: The project defines relShortComplex R ⋙ ShortComplex.π₃, where the third object of its cokernelSequence is (coker _).map on the arrow C(A) → C(X). The blind version is Arrow.forget ⋙ (chains R).mapArrow ⋙ coker. These are the same functor on objects and on maps of pairs, and the equality of functors is rfl.
